comment: Recorded by NativeLightingEffectVectorTests; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_LIGHTING_EFFECT_VECTORS set to this directory. Times are TimeSpan ticks. A constants row records the managed timing constants. A frames row builds one RZ09-0581 effect (colors as RRGGBB hex, directions and durations by name) with a scripted palette selector that returns random in order and a Tidal pair seed in hex, renders it at each elapsed tick, and records for each sample GetNextFrameDelay, ApplyRefreshRateToDelay at 30 Hz and 60 Hz, the canvas frame as RGB hex, and the SHA-256 of the encoded feature report (transaction 1) projected onto layout bytes 0 and 255; draws is how many selections the row used. An advance row records AdvanceFrameDeadline for the effect at the rate.
